title: Orange Pi 5 Plus
notes: 100 x 75 mm and 1.6 mm thick (official 3D model OPI-5PLUS-PCBA.stp, the Mechanical download on the Orange Pi 5 Plus service and support page; the product page gives 100 x 75 mm). The four 3.2 mm holes used here are 87.08 x 49.21 mm apart: 9.81 mm from the l = 0 end, 3.11 mm from the l = L end, 19.63 mm from the s = 0 edge and 6.16 mm from the s = S edge. Two more 3.2 mm holes, at l = 15.59, s = 22.96 and l = 55.59, s = 66.59, are not used; the other holes of 3 mm and more hold the pegs of the Ethernet jack and the standoffs of the two M.2 slots.

s = 0 is the edge with two USB 2.0 ports, the three HDMI ports (two outputs and an input), the two Ethernet ports and a USB-C port. They stick out up to 4.1 mm past it, more than the 4 mm gap to the back plate, so s = S faces the back plate. Along s = S are the microSD slot under the board, the audio jack, the infrared receiver, two buttons, the two USB 3.0 ports and the other USB-C port; the microSD card sticks out 2.3 mm past it and the rest up to 1.7 mm. The 40-pin header runs along the l = 0 end. The M.2 Key E slot with the Wi-Fi card is on top of the board at the l = L end.

Under the board is the M.2 Key M slot. In the official 3D model it holds a 2280 SSD, which reaches 6.4 mm below the board, and the screw holding it 6.1 mm; the other parts under the board reach 2.1 mm at most (the microSD slot). The 8 mm standoffs leave 1.6 mm under the SSD.

Standoffs 6 mm across: the nearest parts under the board are 4.3 mm from a hole centre (a button next to the hole at l = 96.89, s = 68.84 and the microSD slot next to the hole at l = 9.81, s = 68.84). The 3.2 mm holes are for M3 screws.
The microSD slot is under the board at the s = S edge, which faces the back plate: in upright portrait and shelf landscape the card can only be changed with the board off the bracket.
Two rows of three windows between the two pairs of holes, 4 mm clear of the standoffs, with a 6 mm rib between the rows.

Parts: boxes round the parts in the official 3D model, rounded to 0.01 mm: the PCB, the connectors and buttons at the edges, the 40-pin header, the M.2 Key E slot with the Wi-Fi card and, under the board, the microSD slot and the M.2 Key M slot with the SSD.
